shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/Dashboard.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' README.md 2>/dev/null || true && find app -maxdepth 4 -type f -print"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git log --oneline --all -8 && git remote -v && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && git show HEAD:package.json && git show HEAD:app/Dashboard.tsx && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,180p' next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/Dashboard.tsx tsconfig.json package.json && sed -n '1,240p' app/Dashboard.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' .gitignore && git diff --no-index /dev/null next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && find .next -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed -n '1,30p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -depth -type f -delete && find .next -depth -type l -delete && find .next -depth -type d -empty -delete

git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- app/Dashboard.tsx tsconfig.json'
